notes:
ホテル refers to Western-style hotels with beds, from English 'hotel.'

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧:
- ホテル: Western-style (beds, Western food)
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧: Japanese-style (futons, tatami, Japanese food)
